description: This file handles the saving process of a 'Task' record in SuiteCRM, including processing form POST data, managing date/time fields, handling inbound email association, checking access permissions, and redirecting after save.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving bean objects in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ACLController
classes.description: Access Control List controller for permission checks.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the bean object, usually a Task record, to the database.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates a bean object with data from POST request.

methods.name: displayNoAccess
methods.description: Displays a 'No Access' message if the user lacks permission.

methods.name: get_user_time_format
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's preferred time format.

methods.name: merge_time_meridiem
methods.description: Merges meridiem ('AM'/'PM') with a given time value.

methods.name: get_time_format
methods.description: Returns the current time format string.
